name: TechNH, Inc.
old_description: Our proven 5-step transfer process protects supply continuity, confirms tool condition, and gets you back to stable production fast.
about:
TechNH, Inc. was founded in 1982 in a small corner of an old mill building in Nashua, New Hampshire. The company has since relocated to Merrimack, New Hampshire, where it operates as a custom plastic injection molder serving clients worldwide.

The company specializes in precision plastic injection molding, offering insert molding, over-molding, and in-house mold making and repair. Its facility houses injection molding machines ranging from 16 to 780 tons, capable of shot weights from 0.5 to 128 ounces. Secondary services include pad printing, assembly, and packaging. TechNH also provides design for manufacturability, mold flow analysis, and IQ/OQ/PQ validation through an in-house regulatory team. Workforce tenure is notable: nearly 40% of employees have over five years of service, and 25% have exceeded a decade.

TechNH serves the medical, defense, alternative energy, water treatment, and industrial sectors. Customer testimonials reference clients in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Pennsylvania, including healthcare and industrial accounts. The company is ISO 13485:2016 certified by TUV, FDA registered (21 CFR 820), ITAR registered, and UL recognized.

A core differentiator is the company's five-step tool transfer process, designed to protect supply continuity and confirm tool condition without production downtime. TechNH emphasizes in-house mold making and regulatory expertise, allowing it to maintain compliance with critical standards alongside customers. Long-tenured staff and a culture built on adaptability, integrity, enthusiasm, pride in work, and reliability underpin its approach.
